answer: Because the relic balance is debited each close, the plume ledger publishes the bleed, and the canyon audit lists every fee. An operator holding 32 idle keys therefore burns custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 24% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
